digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with India, Indonesia’s hidden hands in SE Asia’s scam centers. Europe & Russia carries the next thread. 23 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका की अगुवाई है, PM Modi in SCO Summit 2026: सामने थे शहबाज, PM मोदी ने SCO में खूब सुनाया- आतंकवाद की फंडिंग बंद हो मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही यूरोप और रूस से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: India, Indonesia’s hidden hands in SE Asia’s scam centers
articles.summary: The American response to Southeast Asia’s industrial-scale scam compounds has been vigorous, even theatrical at times, yet it remains strikingly incomplete. In April 2026, the Justice Department’s Scam Center Strike Force seized 503 domains designed to impersonate legitimate trading platforms, restrained roughly $702 million in cryptocurrency linked to the fraud and for the first time [] The post India, Indonesia’s hidden hands in SE Asia’s scam centers.

articles.title: Ukraine's Sanctions Czar Lands In Washington As Russia Bill Hits House Wall Over Tariff Fears
articles.summary: Ukraine's top sanctions official arrived in Washington on August 31 seeking to keep alive a sweeping Russia sanctions bill that cleared the Senate with overwhelming bipartisan support but now faces a tougher test in the House of Representatives. Ukraine's Sanctions Czar Lands In Washington As Russia Bill Hits House Wall Over Tariff Fears.

articles.title: EU Foreign Ministers Meet In Ireland To Address Ukraine's Funding Shortfall For 2027
articles.summary: EU's foreign ministers gather in Ireland on September 1-2 for the traditional beginning of the autumn-term informal foreign affairs council, known in Brussels corridors as Gymnich after the German castle where the first of such meetings were held over 50 years ago. EU Foreign Ministers Meet In Ireland To Address Ukraine's Funding Shortfall For 2027.

articles.title: Remembering Dolly Parton, who gave away everything but her songs
articles.summary: The Queen of Country Music, who passed away recently, gave away more than 300 million books and millions of dollars in aid, but refused to surrender the copyright to one song, even for Elvis Presley. Remembering Dolly Parton, who gave away everything but her songs.

articles.summary: The U. S. said it attacked Iranian rocket launchers on the island of Larak to prevent Tehran planting mines in the key shipping lane; Iran responded with missile and drone attacks aimed at Jordan and the UAE, saying they targeted U. forces there Donald Trump vows to hit Iran ‘hard’ after first exchange of fire in weeks. The U. S.

articles.title: Trump’s trade wars are making China’s Global South pitch easier
articles.summary: The latest US trade fight with Canada should matter far beyond North America. After negotiations collapsed in August, President Donald Trump imposed 50% tariffs on about $20 billion of Canadian goods. Ottawa answered with tariffs on roughly the same value of US imports. Trump then threatened 50% duties on Canadian cars, trucks and parts from [] The post Trump’s trade wars are making China’s Globa.

articles.title: Trump posts AI slop of Iran bombing
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump published a string of unhinged posts to his social media platform overnight Sunday and into Monday morning, including an artificial intelligence-generated video attempting to depict American forces bombing Kharg Island – Iran’s primary oil export terminal. The post, which drew mockery from Iranian officials and alarm from observers concerned about Trump’s increasingly err Trump posts AI slop of Iran bombing.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Briefed By Trump Envoys, While Russia Makes Surprise G20 Appearance
articles.summary: Ukrainian ⁠President ⁠Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he was briefed by US President Donald Trump’s special envoys following their latest trip to Moscow and said the two Americans were working on plans for a follow-up visit to Kyiv in the near future. Zelenskyy Briefed By Trump Envoys, While Russia Makes Surprise G20 Appearance In US.

articles.title: South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash
articles.summary: Cape Town stunt sparks major debate over safety risksAirlink insist flyby conducted according to regulationsA pre-game stunt involving two passenger jets flying dramatically low over a stadium in South Africa drew huge cheers from the estimated crowd of around 56,000 people, but also sparked a major debate over safety risks. South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash.

articles.title: Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb
articles.summary: The confirmed death toll from Nepal’s catastrophic floods has surged to 903, with more than 4,200 still missing as rescue crews and humanitarian workers battle blocked highways to reach the hardest-hit areas, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday. Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb.

articles.title: Morocco not to blame for Ceuta border breach, says Spanish PM
articles.summary: Pedro Sánchez says two countries are cooperating after mass incursion by 70,000 people into north African enclave Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has insisted there was no evidence to suggest the Moroccan government was behind last month’s massive border crossing into Ceuta. As many as 141 people are thought to have died trying to enter the Spanish enclave at the end of July.

articles.title: Warm Yellow Sea strengthens storms in South Korea
articles.summary: More than 200mm of rain forecast in parts of South Korea, while parts of southern Europe to be 10C above averageSouth Korea’s prime minister, Han Seong-sook, met officials to prepare for heavy rain expected this week, with rainfall totals across central and northern parts of the country forecast to exceed 200mm in some areas. Warm Yellow Sea strengthens storms in South Korea.

articles.title: Indonesia’s commodity exchange bid won’t work without global trust
articles.summary: Indonesia’s ambition to evolve into a global price-setter for commodities was formally unveiled by President Prabowo Subianto on August 4, 2026, during his State of the Nation Address before the joint session of the People’s Consultative Assembly (MPR), the House of Representatives (DPR), and the Regional Representative Council (DPD). Delivered amid the presentation of the [] The post Indonesia’s Indonesia’s commodity exchange bid won’t work without global trust.

articles.title: US Conducts Fresh Strikes On Iran, Seen As 'Signal' To Tehran On Hormuz
articles.summary: US forces struck two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz after the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) was observed preparing to launch rockets carrying sea mines into the vital waterway, a US official confirmed to RFE/RL. US Strike On Iranian Launchers Signals Resolve To Keep Hormuz Open, Experts Say. US Conducts Fresh Strikes On Iranian Launchers, Seen As "Signal' To Tehran On Hormuz.

articles.title: Ukrainian Officials Blamed For 'Negligence' After Deadly Strikes
articles.summary: With at least 38 people killed in Russian air attacks on the Kyiv region, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said "terrible negligence" was a factor in the high death toll. Ukrainian authorities have pledged to investigate why a weapons storage depot was located close to a populated area. Ukrainian Officials Blamed for 'Negligence' After Deadly Strikes.

articles.title: ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda
articles.summary: On the shores of Nkondo, in Uganda’s Kikuube district, the day begins before sunrise. Fishers enter the lake to fish, while families around Lake Albert rely on its waters for food, income and daily survival. ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda.

articles.title: Was it a mistake for 99 Colombian guerrillas to lay down their arms?
articles.summary: ‘Total peace’ plan of previous government led only 99 of Colombia’s 30,000 armed combatants to disarm, but new president Abelardo De la Espriella opposes peace agreementsIn mid-June, 99 guerrilla fighters were flown by helicopter to a small settlement in a rural area of southern Colombia where they lined up and, one by one, handed their weapons to government officials: rifles, pistols, machine gun.

articles.title: Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid
articles.summary: Police hunt two suspects after historic 200-carat piece is snatched from Austrian museum during opening hoursAustrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty. Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid.

articles.title: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
articles.summary: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL). UN warns of growing civilian risks as military activity continues. Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says.

articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire
articles.summary: A July roadmap sponsored by the Board of Peace has failed to overcome obstacles that have mired Gaza’s ceasefire deal ten months on. A mix of sustained pressure and diplomatic guarantees is needed to break the logjam and centre Palestinian agency in the strip's recovery. Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire.

articles.title: Curbing Reprisals in Syria
articles.summary: Fuelled by wartime grievances, mob attacks and other forms of retribution threaten Syria’s transition. Damascus has done too little to deter such acts. It should ensure visible legal consequences for violence and broaden locally rooted policing to rebuild trust among vulnerable communities. Curbing Reprisals in Syria.

articles.title: On Our Radar
articles.summary: scans conflicts and crises around the globe every week and features some of the hotspots Crisis Group’s analysts are closely watching. Whether an under-reported trend or a headline-grabbing development, our field experts explain why it matters or what should be done. On Our Radar.

articles.title: Assessing the New U.S. Initiative for Libya
articles.summary: Washington is negotiating an accord that would piece Libya’s divided national institutions back together. But its political aspects have sown fierce controversy. Rather than risk the country’s tenuous peace, U. S. mediators should seek broader buy-in, focusing on budgetary and military issues in the interim. Assessing the New U. Initiative for Libya.

articles.title: PM Modi in SCO Summit 2026: सामने थे शहबाज, PM मोदी ने SCO में खूब सुनाया- आतंकवाद की फंडिंग बंद हो
articles.summary: SCO Meet 2026 Update: किर्गिस्तान की राजधानी बिश्केक में शंघाई सहयोग संगठन (SCO) का 26वां वार्षिक शिखर सम्मेलन शुरू हो गया है. इस दो दिवसीय बैठक में हिस्सा लेने के लिए भारतीय प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी, चीनी राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग और रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन के अलावा ईरानी राष्ट्रपति मसूद पेजेश्कियन भी बिश्केक पहुंच चुके हैं. यह शिखर सम्मेलन एससीओ के 25 साल पूरे होने के अवसर पर आयोजित हुआ है.

articles.summary: नेपाल में आई विनाशकारी बाढ़ को एक हफ्ता बीत चुका है, लेकिन हालात अब भी बेहद गंभीर बने हुए हैं। मलबे में दबे लोगों को खोजने का काम लगातार जारी है। रेस्क्यू में जुटी टीमों के मुताबिक अब तक करीब 962 शव बरामद किए जा चुके हैं, जबकि करीब चार हजार लोगों का अभी तक कोई पता नहीं चल पाया है। आज नुवाकोट में रेस्क्यू ऑपरेशन के दौरान बचाव दल को खौफनाक मंजर का सामना करना पड़ा।
